messages.content: ترجم كل وحدة إنجليزية إلى العربية الفصحى بدقة واكتمال، مع حفظ المعنى والأسماء والإشارات الكتابية. لا تضف أسماء أو معلومات غير موجودة في النص، ولا تكتب ملاحظات أو شروحاً. أخرج JSON مطابقاً للمخطط فقط. يجب أن تكون chapter وverse عددين صحيحين بأرقام 0-9، وأن يكون text_ar ترجمة الوحدة وحدها.

{"chapter":11,"verses":[{"chapter":11,"text":"Behold, the head turned with those who were with it, and ate the two under wings that planned to reign.","verse":31},{"chapter":11,"text":"But this head held the whole earth in possession, and ruled over those who dwell in it with much oppression. It had stronger governance over the world than all the wings that had gone before.","verse":32},{"chapter":11,"text":"After this I saw, and behold, the head also that was in the middle suddenly disappeared, like the wings.","verse":33},{"chapter":11,"text":"But the two heads remained, which also reigned the same way over the earth and over those who dwell in it.","verse":34},{"chapter":11,"text":"I saw, and behold, the head on the right side devoured the one that was on the left side.","verse":35}],"book_code":"2ES"}

response_format: JSON schema with book_code and verses. Each item has integer chapter, integer verse, and Arabic text_ar. Return exactly source verse numbers 31,32,33,34,35 in this chapter.
